# skycloak_realm_role (Resource)

A realm-scoped role. Assign it to users with `skycloak_realm_user_role_assignment`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_realm_role" "admin" {
  cluster_id  = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name  = skycloak_realm.app.name
  name        = "admin"
  description = "Administrators"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `name` (String) Role name. Immutable (renaming recreates the role).
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name. Immutable.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-friendly role description.

### Read-Only

- `client_role` (Boolean) Whether this is a client-scoped role.
- `composite` (Boolean) Whether this role is composed from other roles.
- `id` (String) Composite ID `cluster_id/realm_name/role_name`.
